title: chore(console): move the objectui pin cf153eb2e535 → 56cf4d8e89b7, past objectui#13316's CSV import door, so PR #25130 can land
body:
Fixes #25151
Clause-②: no

This PR moves the console pin from `cf153eb2e535` to `56cf4d8e89b7`: objectui `main` at `56cf4d8e89b71586e4d9bb9921433d44b03addf3`. That commit is the merge of objectstack-ai/objectui#13316 (objectui#13315), objectui's half of #25078's two-repo fix: objectui's Import Wizard and identity import send a `.csv` / `.tsv` / `.txt` file to the import door as CSV text. It is also objectui `main`'s tip. With this pin on `main`, #25078's PR #25130 can merge `main` over it and land.

This PR is not a release act. It does not touch the Version Packages PR and dispatches no release workflow. No objectui source changed, nothing was written to objectui, and no product code, `.github/workflows/**` or `scripts/build-console.sh` is in the diff.

**Tier:** not governed. `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/issue-25151-objectui-pin-13316` at `c331b2c9e`: "0 of 4 path(s) hit the register (7 surfaces govern objectstack) ... NOT governed", exit 0. Size: 4 files, +40 / -8.

## Choosing the pin

The pin is judged on objectui's **push and merge-group CI** for this commit, as earlier pin moves were. That is the seat's ruling in claim amendment `6330756861` on #25151. There is no newer objectui `main` commit to consider: `56cf4d8e89b7` is the tip.

- **Push CI, all success.** objectui `CI` run **39702726461**, event `push`, branch `main`, head `56cf4d8e89b7`, attempt 1: all 31 jobs `success`, coverage shards included. The other push runs on the commit are also `success`: Lint 39702726493, Repo Gates 39702726453, Changeset Release 39702726466, Changeset Guard 39702726440 and Bundle Analysis 39702726467.
- **Merge-group CI, all success.** On `gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-13316-…`: CI 39701528761, Lint, Repo Gates, Changeset Presence and Governed Surface Guard.
- **The one red is a scheduled run, recorded here, not hidden.** The scheduled `CI` run **39703234572** (event `schedule`, created 01:01:32Z) on the same commit concluded `failure` on two jobs. `Test (coverage shard 5/8)` failed on `apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.leaveGuard-13163.test.tsx`, case "after a successful save the page is clean again: no prompt" (`AssertionError: expected true to be false`). Its aggregator `Test (coverage)` then reported "Coverage gate did NOT run | shards=failure". Tally of `commits/56cf4d8e89b7/check-runs` at 2026-10-22T01:38:21Z: 99 check-runs, 94 `success`, 3 `skipped`, 2 `failure` (these two), 0 in progress.
  - **Why this is not taken as a red pin:**
    - The range `cf153eb2e535..56cf4d8e89b7` does not touch that test file. In a full clone, it last changed in `7a5f26715` (objectstack-ai/objectui#13204), an ancestor of the old pin (`merge-base --is-ancestor` exit 0). The component it tests, `SettingsView.tsx`, last changed in `0093b2c82` (objectstack-ai/objectui#13298), which is in this range.
    - The same file passed in the push run on this same commit.
    - Both of those changes are in `7e9708e632`. I read 11 scheduled `CI` runs on that commit (13:34Z to 23:32Z on 2026-10-21): 9 passed, and the 2 that failed did so on infrastructure (a test shard with no conclusion, a `Type Check` timeout), not on this test.
    - Rerun locally 5 times at `56cf4d8e89b7`, from the root of the objectui tree that `build-console.sh` built, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsView.leaveGuard-13163.test.tsx`. Each run exited 0 with "Test Files 1 passed (1)" and "Tests 12 passed (12)"; lock VERDICT `command-exit 0`.
  - The seat files the flake in objectui, for objectui's own lane.
- **Ancestry,** in a full (non-shallow) scratch clone of objectui (`--is-shallow-repository` false):
  - the old pin `cf153eb2e535` is an ancestor of `56cf4d8e89b7`: exit 0;
  - control, the reverse (`56cf4d8e89b7` an ancestor of `cf153eb2e535`): exit 1;
  - `56cf4d8e89b7` is `origin/main`'s tip, and `bump-objectui.sh` reports it "(on origin/main)".

## What the move carries: 19 commits

`git log cf153eb2e535..56cf4d8e89b7` in the full clone: 19 non-merge commits, 0 merges. One line each, newest first. **FLAG** marks a commit that changes a contract the console build or a pinned record in this repo reads.

- `56cf4d8e8` plugin-grid, app-shell: a CSV file reaches the import door as CSV text (objectstack-ai/objectui#13316). **FLAG, by design:** the import-door contract, objectui's half of #25078. The CSV import now sends `format: 'csv'` with CSV text to this repo's import door.
- `7e9708e63` app-shell: register the console home blocks under the app-shell namespace (objectstack-ai/objectui#13314). **FLAG, SDUI registry:** `hero`, `stat`, `usage-bar`, `checklist` and `tile-grid` register under namespace `app-shell`, and objectui's own `known-schema-types` list gains five `app-shell:` keys. Measured effect here: none. The regenerated `sdui.manifest.json` is byte-identical (107 components, sha256 `d1fde278ffd6…`), so it is not in this diff.
- `78bd6d732` app-shell: the /data filter bar offers single-value relation fields (objectstack-ai/objectui#13313)
- `f5e42cad4` types: stop authoring the retired addRecord.mode / formView in two spec-alignment tests (objectstack-ai/objectui#13312). Tests only.
- `13c92e78d` data-objectstack: the batch-6 DroppedFieldsEvent reason pin with stored_expression subtracted (objectstack-ai/objectui#13311). Tests only.
- `279425409` app-shell: the Position preview lists the permission sets a position declares (objectstack-ai/objectui#13307). It reads the spec key `position.permissionSets`, which this tree declares (`packages/spec/src/identity/position.zod.ts`). The console's `tsc` build passed against this tree's spec.
- `601c406dd` react: the withholding console line names an element, not a navigation entry (objectstack-ai/objectui#13306)
- `3aafc0d53` react: a page node whose visibility predicate faults is withheld (objectstack-ai/objectui#13302)
- `813c3d973` fields: password inputs carry an autocomplete token (objectstack-ai/objectui#13300)
- `0093b2c82` console: a settings value that misses its declared format blocks Save (objectstack-ai/objectui#13298). This is the last change to `SettingsView.tsx`, the component under the scheduled run's red test above.
- `7c405b73a` components: a page:tabs item whose visibleWhen faults withholds its tab (objectstack-ai/objectui#13297)
- `f66973232` plugin-detail: show an object-level rule refusal without the _record label (objectstack-ai/objectui#13296)
- `c8f8b10ad` components: select-all, the row checkboxes and the row numbers share one centre line (objectstack-ai/objectui#13294)
- `fbb4b23bf` components, plugin-grid: selecting a cell's text neither opens the record nor starts an edit (objectstack-ai/objectui#13192)
- `8701f1e76` components, fields: head a widget-hinted nameField through its face (objectstack-ai/objectui#13291). This is the range's one `minor` changeset.
- `a91f6bbb1` console: the approvals inbox opens a request on its served page (objectstack-ai/objectui#13290). **FLAG, served-page contract:** the console now navigates to the standard record route, which mounts this repo's page `sys_approval_request_detail` (present here: `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.page.ts`).
- `3aa2f5261` release packages (objectstack-ai/objectui#11600). **FLAG, versions:** `@object-ui/*` moves from 17.7.0 to 18.0.0, and so does `objectuiWorkspaceVersion` in `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`. `check-sdui-manifest`'s version oracle agrees: 18.0.0. This commit carries no objectui changeset.
- `53dea27af` app-shell: give the package dialog's Dependencies row a key/value editor (objectstack-ai/objectui#13284)
- `9e1bff63a` app-shell: the app report index lists the reports its navigation ships (objectstack-ai/objectui#13283)

**Unchanged over the range:**
- objectui's `.objectstack-sha`: `06cab4849a8a` at both ends.
- `pnpm-lock.yaml`, the root `package.json`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and `apps/console/vite.config.ts`: no diff.
- `packages/sdui-parser/src`: 0 diff lines, so the lockstep blobs stay as they are and no parser port is owed.
- `packages/types/src`: only two test files change.

## The procedure, as written

No shared objectui checkout was written to. `/home/user/objectui` is shallow and shared, so every objectui read came from a full scratch clone that `OBJECTUI_ROOT` names, and `build-console.sh`'s build worktree registration landed in that clone. Exit codes were captured before any pipe, and the heavy steps ran under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

| step | command and reading | exit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| bump | `OBJECTUI_ROOT=SCRATCH_CLONE bash scripts/bump-objectui.sh 56cf4d8e89b71586e4d9bb9921433d44b03addf3 --no-commit`: "cf153eb2e535..56cf4d8e89b7 walks completely", "16 releasing changeset(s), 0 breaking (0 declared major, 0 annotated), 2 release-nothing, 1 commit(s) without a changeset — objectui declared `minor`, recorded as `patch`", "objectui pin: cf153eb2e535 → 56cf4d8e89b7 (on origin/main)", "wrote changeset console-56cf4d8e89b7.md (@objectstack/console: patch)". `--no-commit` is used only so the commit carries this repo's trailer pair; the files are the script's own | 0 |
| build | The seven `@objectstack/*` packages objectui installs by commit (client, core, formula, lint, sdui-parser, spec, types), with their closure: `turbo run build ... --concurrency=2`, 37 packages. Then `OBJECTUI_ROOT=SCRATCH_CLONE OBJECTUI_DEPS_BUILD_CMD='pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console^... --concurrency=2' bash scripts/build-console.sh` (= `pnpm objectui:build`). Lock VERDICT `command-exit 0`, held 689 s | 0 |

**The console build's closing checks,** at `aabbc29a3`, the bump commit. The later commits add the manifest record, the lockstep record and the merge of `main` `2aaee3b24`. That merge brings #25145 and #25147, which touch `packages/runtime`, `service-automation`, `plugin-auth`, `plugin-email` and `verify`, none of them one of the seven packages the console bundle packs (`git diff --name-only` over those seven: empty).
- "Bundle canary 'import/jobs' present".
- "Single-zod canary: exactly one zod version literal {major:4,minor:6,patch:7}", over 2261 `assets/*.js` files.
- "Console bundle carries THIS tree's @objectstack/spec, and only it". All 26 injected-only descriptions are present, and all 5 pin-only descriptions are absent.
- "@objectstack/console dist ready (65708 KB) from objectui@56cf4d8e89b7".
- `pnpm check:console-sha`: "Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@56cf4d8e89b7)".

The Console Pin Gate does not run on a PR or in the merge queue (`ci.yml`'s `console-pin` job excludes `pull_request` and `merge_group`). So this local build is the pre-merge reading. `main`'s first full-battery run after the merge rebuilds the console fresh at `56cf4d8e89b7`, because this PR changes `.objectui-sha` and so misses the console-dist cache key.
